reasoning: 驗證目標：若 HU 持續處於 Paused 狀態直到緩衝區幾乎被尚未收聽的內容填滿，HU 在到達緩衝區終點前一分鐘顯示彈出訊息。關鍵情境條件：暫停持續到距離緩衝區終點一分鐘的時點——這是條文給出的明確時間邊界。為什麼這樣切：驗證對象是該時間邊界，設計方法採邊界值分析；一條 TC 覆蓋單一觸發的必然結果，依 §5.7 不拆分。只驗彈窗有出現而不驗出現的時點，等於沒有驗到條文真正規範的內容（提前一分鐘），因此程序以計時方式核對。刻意略過：彈出訊息的文字與版面不在條文內，且本 corpus 未引用 Pop Up List，ER 只驗其出現與時點；到達終點後的自動恢復由 075 覆蓋。

tcs.tc_title: Pop-up warns one minute before the buffer end is reached
tcs.test_item: If the HU remains in the Paused state until the buffer is almost full with yet-to-be-listened to content, a pop-up shall be displayed, one minute prior to reaching the end of the buffer
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. The buffer is empty at the start of the test
5. Playback is placed in the Paused state and left there
tcs.input_test_data:
Buffer capacity: the maximum retention the HU provides on one channel
Warning point under test: 1 minute before the buffer reaches its end
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Request Pause and start a stopwatch
2. Leave the HU paused and read the screen while the buffer fills
3. Read the stopwatch at the moment a pop-up is displayed
4. Read the remaining time until the buffer reaches its end
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU is in the Paused state and the buffer starts filling
2. No pop-up is displayed while the buffer is filling
3. A pop-up indicating the buffer state is displayed
4. One minute of buffer capacity remains at the moment the pop-up is displayed
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
